requirements_summary: Primary: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS/HSM (BYOK). Must support AWS KMS (with CloudHSM), Azure Key Vault Managed HSM, and GCP KMS CMEK.
Keys: customer-controlled root keys, support for envelope encryption, monthly rotation, crypto-agility (ability to swap keys without downtime).
HSM: require FIPS 140-2/3 attestation and tamper-evident HSM hardware for key import and signing operations; attestation docs required for procurement.
BYOK flow: secure key import/export procedures, audit trail of import transactions, deterministic key IDs, and zero-knowledge proof that private key material is not exported by vendor runtime.
Audit & logging: CloudTrail/Activity logs forwarded to customer's SIEM (Splunk); KMS access logs correlated with request traces in Redwood Console; immutable retention for 7+ years (per compliance).
Data residency: keys must reside in customer-chosen region; cross-region replication only under explicit policy; policy-driven routing to avoid data egress.
Operational: ability to run local envelope-decrypt in the VPC to avoid plaintext tokens leaving the data plane; detailed runbook for key compromise scenarios and emergency rotation.
Performance: target added latency for key operations <=50ms p99 for same-region; batching of KV cache ops to reduce KMS calls for high-throughput chat/embedding workloads.
Integration: provide Terraform modules and ARM templates for Key Vault + VNet + route tables; sample KMS connector configs for GCP KMS and BYOK manifests.
Compliance: SOC2/ISO artifacts required, plus supply-chain/HSM vendor attestations; contractual clauses for data residency and breach notification timelines.
Deliverables for procurement: architecture diagram, KMS attestation pack, sample audit log export, BYOK addendum, performance baseline report (AWS/Azure/GCP).
